title: Flow Computation Two Column Layout
description: Change flow computation nodes from three-column layout (inputs | vertical name | outputs) to two-column layout (inputs | outputs) with horizontal name centered above the rectangle.
summary: Fixed computation node title sitting too far above the rectangle: label height from label_extent is screen px and was applied as world offset (scaling with zoom²). Position now converts screen gap + half label height to world space via zoom. Tighter 0.2× label gap. WASM rebuilt.
